content.text:
Both web MCPs are connected and verified working.

- **Linear** (claude.ai connector at `https://mcp.linear.app/mcp`) returned the WEVO workspace. Tools are available as `mcp__claude_ai_Linear__*`.
- **Slack** (claude.ai connector at `https://mcp.slack.com/mcp`) returned channel search results. Tools are available as `mcp__claude_ai_Slack__*`.

The 404 you saw came from a separate, stale project-level entry named `linear-server` pointing at the retired `/sse` endpoint. I removed it from the local config, so `/mcp` should stop reporting that failure. The duplicate project-level `notion` entry remains since the claude.ai Notion connector already covers it. Say the word if you want that one removed too.
